Mechanism_Event: FCC and HCP elastic up to ~200 MPa
Notes: Pre-yield stage only. Stage-specific zero must not be interpreted as condition-level negative target.
TRIP begins at approximately the macroscopic yield onset.

Mechanism_Event: HCP yields by tensile twinning; TRIP continues
Notes: {10.2} tensile twinning in HCP inferred from ~90 degree reorientation and grain-intensity bifurcation.

Mechanism_Event: Compression/multiple HCP twinning plus slip; TRIP rate changes
Notes: Compression twinning and multiple twin systems activated; large-scale slip also contributes.

Mechanism_Event: TRIP gradually suppressed at large strain but persists to fracture
Notes: Transformation rate decreases above ~25% strain; this is not TRIP absence.

Mechanism_Event: Fracture after persistent TRIP and HCP twinning/slip
Notes: ~17% FCC remains at fracture. Do not derive an exact HCP fraction unless explicitly reported as such.
